about_the_game:
Sharpen your mind and get ready to slide your way to victory!

Sliding Knight is a charming low-poly strategy puzzle game where every move matters. You control a brave little knight who can only move by sliding — once he starts, he won’t stop until he hits something. With a limited number of moves per level, you'll need to plan every step with precision and think several turns ahead.

There’s no story to follow, but every level is its own little challenge. Cleverly designed maps, sneaky traps, and surprising layouts will constantly test your spatial reasoning and logic.
The cute visuals and minimalist world create a relaxing atmosphere, while the puzzles offer that satisfying “Aha!” moment when you finally solve them.

With its steadily increasing difficulty and intuitive mechanics, Sliding Knight is a perfect pick for players of all ages who enjoy puzzles, brain-teasers, and strategic thinking.

Every move counts — and every decision brings you closer to triumph... or failure.
